_README: Configuration for viewshed_null.py — the eleven Parion foci and the seven
contextually related pairs tested in the manuscript.
BEFORE RUNNING: replace every "FILL" with the real map coordinate, in the
same projected CRS as the DEM (TUREF / TM27, EPSG:5253 for the W25 dataset).
The script refuses to run while any placeholder remains.
The eight foci named below are the ones the manuscript names explicitly.
Three of the eleven are not named in the running text — add them here with
the same names used in the Figure 8 panel labels, so that the output table
If you keep pre-computed GRASS viewsheds in --observed-dir, each file must
be named <name>.tif using exactly the "name" values below.

viewshed_parameters.note: Uniform pedestrian baseline. No allowance is made for tower superstructures or for the original height of the tumulus mound, so elevated foci are conservative lower bounds.

null_model.note: The 2 m analysis grid is the effective resolution of the low-pass filtered surface; the nominal 0.4 m grid is oversampled for this purpose.
